verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only adjacent pieces: Azure CLI install commands (brew install azure-cli), a marketing tagline about quickly creating cloud apps, and free-account pages. No item documents an official quickstart that goes from zero to a running, deployed service with the exact commands shown, and nothing evidences a first deploy in under an hour. The retired Learn sandbox further indicates exercises now require a real subscription.

support.subject: As a developer, first deploy is under an hour — official quickstarts that go from zero to a running service with the exact commands shown
